description:
The National War Museum in Umuahia explores Nigeria’s military history, with a particular focus on the Nigerian Civil War and Biafra.

Military equipment and historical relics form important parts of its interpretation. Tanks, armoured vehicles, vessels and aircraft connect the museum’s account with the material history of conflict.

description:
The Natural History Museum in Maputo is administered by Eduardo Mondlane University. Founded in 1911, it has occupied a distinctive Manueline-inspired building since 1933.

Zoological specimens and ethnographic interpretation introduce Mozambique’s natural and cultural heritage. Its grounds also include murals by Malangatana, connecting scientific collections with the city’s artistic life.
